title: Gida da ado
description: Ten stories about homes and how people furnish and keep them: a bride decorating her sitting room, mice in a storeroom, a fall from the roof while cleaning the water tank, a widowed grandmother and her doves, shopping for furniture with an adviser, a garden competition, a teenager and a dance party, a fiqh teacher's entrance hall, a rubbish fire in a rented compound, and a grandfather's old photo album.

lessons.title: Falon Surayya
lessons.summary: In Kano, the young bride Surayya, who loves style, decorates the sitting room of her new house: the floor is polished until it shines, a mat is spread, her husband puts up hooks for a picture of the Two Holy Mosques; when her close relatives visit, her mother sees how much the room resembles her own.
lessons.text:
Surayya amarya ce. Watanni biyu da suka wuce ta auri Sa'ad, kuma suka koma wani sabon gida a Kano. Gidan yana da ɗakuna uku, ɗakin girki, da kuma falo babba. Tun ranar farko Surayya ta ce wa mijinta, "Falon nan shi ne fuskar gidanmu. Duk wanda ya shigo, falo ne zai fara gani."

Sa'ad ya yi dariya ya ce, "To, ki yi wa falon ado yadda kike so. Na san ke 'yar gayu ce." Gaskiya ne. Tun tana yarinya Surayya tana son gayu: tana son kaya masu kyau, launuka masu daɗi da kuma gida mai tsabta. Ƙawayenta sukan ce ita ce 'yar gayu a cikinsu.

Abu na farko da ta duba shi ne daɓe. Daɓen falon na siminti ne, ba shi da kyau, kuma ƙura tana tashi daga cikinsa. Sai ta kira wani mai aiki ya goge daɓen, ya shafa masa wani magani, har ya fara sheƙi kamar gilashi. Da rana, idan hasken rana ya shigo ta taga, sai ka ga daɓen yana sheƙi. Surayya ta ce, "Ina son wannan sheƙi."

Bayan haka ta sayi wata babbar tabarma mai launin kore da fari. Ta shimfiɗa tabarmar a tsakiyar falo, a gaban kujeru. Ta ce wa Sa'ad, "Baƙin da suka saba zama a ƙasa za su zauna a kan tabarma, waɗanda suke son kujera kuma su zauna a kan kujera."

Sai kuma bango. Surayya tana da wani babban hoto na Masallatai Tsarkaka guda biyu, wato Masallacin Makka da na Madina. Mahaifiyarta ce ta ba ta hoton ranar aurenta. Ta roƙi Sa'ad ya kafa ƙugi a bango. Sa'ad ya hau kujera, ya buga ƙugi da ƙarfe, sannan ya rataya hoton a kan ƙugin. Ya kuma kafa wani ƙugi kusa da ƙofa, inda za a riƙa rataya makullan gida.

Da ta gama, ta tsaya a ƙofar falo tana kallo. Sai ta ga wani abu da ya ba ta mamaki: akwai kamanceceniya sosai tsakanin falonta da falon mahaifiyarta. Tabarma a ƙasa, hoton Masallatai Tsarkaka a bango, kujeru a gefe. Ta yi dariya ta ce, "Ashe ba ni na zaɓi wannan ado ba. Mahaifiyata ce ta koya mini shi tun ina ƙarama."

A ranar Juma'a makusanta suka zo ganin sabon gidan: mahaifiyar Surayya, 'yan'uwanta mata biyu, da ƙanin Sa'ad. Su ne maziyarta na farko a gidan. Kowane ɗaya daga cikin maziyartan ya yaba wa falon. Mahaifiyarta ta duba bango, ta ga hoton Masallatai Tsarkaka, sai ta yi murmushi. Ta ce, "Ai na ga kamanceceniya da falona!"

Surayya ta ce, "Haka ne, Mama. Ke ce malamata."

Da yamma, bayan makusanta sun tafi, Sa'ad ya ce, "Maziyarta sun ji daɗi sosai. Yanzu ki huta." Amma Surayya tana kallon daɓen da yake sheƙi, tana tunanin labulen da za ta saya a mako mai zuwa.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Surayya ta ce falo shi ne fuskar gida?
Ta ce duk wanda ya shigo gida, falo ne zai fara gani.
Me aka yi wa daɓen falon?
An goge daɓen aka shafa masa magani, har ya fara sheƙi.
Me Sa'ad ya rataya a kan ƙugi?
Sa'ad ya rataya hoton Masallatai Tsarkaka a kan ƙugi.
Wace kamanceceniya Surayya ta gani?
Ta ga kamanceceniya tsakanin falonta da falon mahaifiyarta.
Su wane ne maziyarta na farko a gidan?
Makusanta ne: mahaifiyar Surayya, 'yan'uwanta mata biyu da ƙanin Sa'ad.

lessons.title: Ɓeraye a sito
lessons.summary: In Zaria, Hajiya Mahbuba finds crumbs of grain all over the storeroom behind her house; her son Jabiru warns that mice multiply fast, finds a nest in an old table drawer, and a commotion follows; at night, in the silence, a trap catches the last mouse, and the grain goes into metal drums.
lessons.text:
Hajiya Mahbuba tana da wani ƙaramin sito a bayan gidanta a Zaria. A cikin sito ɗin take ajiye buhunan masara da gero, tukwane, da kuma babban turmi da ta gada daga wajen mahaifiyarta. Kowace safiya takan shiga sito, ta ɗebo hatsi, ta zuba a cikin turmi, ta daka shi.

Wata safiya da ta shiga sito, sai ta ga barbashi a ƙasa: barbashin masara, barbashin gero, har ma da barbashin takarda. Ta duba buhun masara, sai ta ga wani rami a ƙasansa. Ta ce a ranta, "Wannan aikin ɓera ne."

Bayan kwana uku abin ya ƙara muni. Barbashi ya cika ƙasar sito, kuma buhunan sun yi ramuka da dama. Har turmi ma ta same shi cike da barbashin hatsi da kashin ɓera. Sai Hajiya Mahbuba ta kira ɗanta Jabiru a waya. Ta ce masa, "Jabiru, ɓeraye sun shiga sito, kuma ina ganin suna hayayyafa. Da ɗaya ne kawai, yanzu sun yi yawa."

Jabiru ya ce, "Mama, ɓera yana saurin hayayyafa. Idan ba a ɗauki mataki da wuri ba, cikin 'yan watanni za su cika gidan."

Ranar Asabar Jabiru ya zo. Ya shiga sito tare da mahaifiyarsa, ya fara fitar da buhunan ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kusurwar sito akwai wani tsohon tebur mai durowa biyu. Jabiru ya ja durowa ta farko, babu komai a ciki sai tsofaffin takardu. Ya ja durowa ta biyu, sai ga wani babban ɓera ya yi tsalle ya fito, 'ya'yansa ƙanana suna bin sa.

Hajiya Mahbuba ta razana. Ta yi ihu, ta yi tsalle ta hau kan wani benci. Jabiru ma ya ɗan razana, amma ya bi ɓerayen da sanda. A cikin gudu, sai ya yi wa wani bokiti shuri, bokitin ya faɗi, ruwa ya zube a ƙasa. Aka yi hatsaniya sosai a sito. Yaran maƙwabta suka ji ihu, suka zo da gudu suna dariya. Jabiru ya sake yi wa wani akwati shuri don ɓera ya fito daga bayansa. Da hatsaniya ta lafa, an kashe ɓeraye biyu, sauran kuma sun gudu.

Jabiru ya ce, "'Ya'yan nan alama ce cewa suna hayayyafa a nan." Ya fitar da tsohon teburin da durowarsa, ya kai shi waje. Ya cike ramukan bango da siminti. Da dare kuma ya kafa tarko a tsakiyar sito, ya sa gyaɗa a ciki. Shi da mahaifiyarsa suka zauna a falo, gida ya yi tsit. Can cikin dare, a cikin wannan tsit, sai suka ji ƙara daga sito. Tarko ya kama ɓera na ƙarshe.

Washegari Jabiru ya sayo gangunan ƙarfe, suka zuba hatsin a ciki. Ya kuma ajiye turmi a kan wani dogon tebur, nesa da ƙasa. Hajiya Mahbuba ta ce, "Yanzu sito ya yi tsit. Babu barbashi, babu hatsaniya." Jabiru ya ce, "Amma, Mama, kada ki sake ajiye hatsi a cikin tsohuwar durowa."

Tambayoyi:
Me Hajiya Mahbuba take ajiyewa a cikin sito?
Tana ajiye buhunan masara da gero, tukwane da babban turmi.
Ina Jabiru ya sami ɓera da 'ya'yansa?
Ya same su a cikin durowa ta biyu ta tsohon tebur.
Me ya sa aka yi hatsaniya a sito?
Ɓeraye sun fito, Hajiya Mahbuba ta razana ta yi ihu, Jabiru ya yi wa bokiti shuri, yara kuma suka zo da gudu.
Yaya tarko ya kama ɓera na ƙarshe?
Da dare gida ya yi tsit, sai suka ji ƙara daga sito: tarko ya kama ɓera.

lessons.title: Tankar ruwa
lessons.summary: In Kaduna, Malam Abbas climbs onto his sloping roof to clean the dirty water tank himself; in the heat he takes off his jacket, sweats, and ignores the safety belt his wife Hasna bought; he slips, rolls down the slope onto a heap of sand and loses consciousness for a few minutes, and later hands the belt to the worker who finishes the job.
lessons.text:
A saman gidan Malam Abbas a Kaduna akwai wata babbar tanka ta ruwa. Ruwan famfo yakan zo da dare, sai inji ya tura shi cikin tanka, daga nan kuma ruwan ya sauko zuwa ɗakin girki da banɗaki. Watanni da dama ba a wanke tankar ba, kuma ruwan da yake fitowa ya fara canza launi.

Wata ranar Asabar Malam Abbas ya ce wa matarsa Hasna, "Yau zan hau rufi in wanke tankar nan da kaina. Ba zan biya wani kuɗi ba."

Hasna ta ce, "Rufin gidan nan yana da gangara sosai. Me zai hana ka kira masu aikin?"

"Kada ki damu," in ji shi.

Ya sa jekan ɗinsa mai kauri, saboda iska tana kaɗawa da safe, ya ɗauki tsani da bokiti. Darewa kan rufin ba ƙaramin aiki ba ne. Tsanin ya yi gajere, sai da ya taka katanga kafin ya kai saman rufin. Da ya gama darewa, ya tsaya yana numfashi, yana kallon gangara da ke gabansa.

Rana ta fara hawa, zafi ya ƙaru. Zufa ta fara zuba daga goshinsa. Sai ya tuɓe jekan ɗin, ya ajiye shi a gefen tankar. Ya kuma tuɓe hularsa. Ya buɗe tankar, ya ga laka a ƙasanta. Ya fara kwashe lakar da bokiti, yana zubar da ita a bayan gida. Zufa ta jiƙa rigarsa duka.

Hasna ta fito tsakar gida, ta ɗaga kai ta ce, "Abbas, ka ɗaura bel ɗin nan da na saya maka! Kada ka yi aiki ba tare da bel ba." Makon jiya ta sayo masa wani bel na musamman mai igiya. Ana ɗaura bel ɗin a jiki, a kuma ɗaura igiyarsa a jikin wani ƙarfe, don kada mutum ya faɗi.

Malam Abbas ya ce, "Na kusa gamawa." Bai ɗaura bel ɗin ba.

Sai tsautsayi ya faru. Da ya ɗauki bokitin ƙarshe ya juya, ƙafarsa ta taka wurin da ruwa ya zuba a kan rufin kwano. Ya zame, ya faɗi a kan gangara, ya fara mirgina. Ya mirgina har zuwa bakin rufin, sannan ya faɗo a kan wani tulin yashi a ƙasa. Bokitin ma ya mirgina ya faɗo kusa da shi.

Hasna ta yi ihu ta ruga wajensa. Malam Abbas bai motsa ba: ya fita hayyacinsa. Maƙwabta suka zo da gudu. Wani ya kawo ruwa, aka yayyafa masa a fuska. Bayan 'yan mintuna ya buɗe ido, ya dawo hayyacinsa. Abu na farko da ya tambaya shi ne, "Ina jekan ɗina?"

Aka kai shi asibiti. Likita ya duba shi ya ce, "Ka gode wa Allah. Yashin nan ne ya cece ka. Irin wannan tsautsayi zai iya kashe mutum." Ya ji rauni a hannu kawai.

Bayan mako biyu, wani mai aiki ya zo don ya gama wanke tankar. Kafin ya fara darewa kan rufin, Malam Abbas ya ba shi bel ɗin ya ce, "Ka ɗaura wannan, ɗan'uwa. Ni na koyi darasi."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Malam Abbas ya hau rufi?
Ya hau rufi ne don ya wanke tankar ruwa.
Me ya sa ya tuɓe jekan ɗinsa?
Rana ta yi zafi, zufa kuma tana zuba daga goshinsa, sai ya tuɓe jekan ɗin.
Me Hasna ta ce masa ya ɗaura?
Ta ce masa ya ɗaura bel ɗin da ta saya masa.
Yaya tsautsayin ya faru?
Ƙafarsa ta taka ruwa, ya zame, ya mirgina a kan gangara, ya faɗo a kan yashi.
Me ya faru bayan ya faɗo?
Ya fita hayyacinsa, amma bayan 'yan mintuna ya dawo hayyacinsa.

lessons.title: Kurciyoyin kaka
lessons.summary: In Katsina, Hajiya Amatu has been a widow for six months and grief has made her weak and thin; her granddaughter Samiha moves in, moves her sleeping place to a bright room, rubs her legs every night and feeds the doves her grandfather kept; there is no news of her son Maikano in Saudi Arabia until he calls from hospital, and the family gathers when he comes home.
lessons.text:
Hajiya Amatu ta zama bazawara watanni shida da suka wuce, lokacin da mijinta ya rasu bayan doguwar jinya. Tun daga lokacin tana zaune ita kaɗai a babban gidansu a Katsina.

Jikarta Samiha ta ce za ta koma gidan kakarta ta zauna da ita. Da ta isa, sai ta ga kakarta ta rame sosai. Jimami ya raunana ta: ba ta cin abinci da kyau, ba ta fita, ba ta hira da maƙwabta kamar yadda ta saba.

Abu na farko da Samiha ta yi shi ne gyara makwanci. Kakarta tana kwana a wani ɗaki mai duhu a can ƙarshen gida, ɗakin da ita da mijinta suka zauna shekaru arba'in. Samiha ta ce, "Kaka, mu mayar da makwancinki zuwa ɗakin da ke kusa da tsakar gida. Akwai haske a can, kuma za ki ji muryar mutane." Hajiya Amatu ta yarda. Samiha ta wanke ɗakin, ta shimfiɗa sabon zanen gado, ta kuma sa labule mai launin shuɗi a taga.

Kowane dare kafin barci, Samiha takan murza ƙafafun kakarta da mai. Yayin da Samiha take murza ƙafafun, kakar takan ba ta labarin rayuwarsu ta baya: yadda ta zama amarya, yadda suka gina gidan, da yadda mijinta yake son kurciya.

A saman zauren gidan akwai wani gidan kurciya na katako da mijinta ya gina. Kurciya da yawa suna zaune a ciki. Tun da ya rasu, babu wanda yake ba su abinci. Samiha ta ce, "Kaka, mu riƙa ba kurciya abinci kamar yadda kakana yake yi." Daga ranar, kowace safiya kakar da jikarta suna zuba gero a tsakar gida, kurciya kuma suna sauka su ci. Hajiya Amatu ta fara murmushi idan ta ga kurciya suna tafiya a kan gero.

Amma akwai wani abu da yake ƙara mata jimami. Ɗanta na farko, Maikano, yana aiki a Saudiyya. Tun lokacin da mahaifinsa ya rasu, ba a ji duriyarsa ba. Hajiya Amatu takan ce, "Ko lafiya yake? Ban ji duriyarsa ba tsawon wata huɗu."

Samiha ta nemi abokan Maikano a intanet, ta aika musu da saƙonni. Bayan mako biyu, wata rana wayar Samiha ta yi ƙara. Maikano ne! Ya ce wayarsa ta ɓace, kuma ya kwanta a asibiti saboda rashin lafiya, shi ya sa ba a ji duriyarsa ba. Yanzu ya warke, kuma zai dawo gida a ƙarshen wata.

A ranar da ya dawo, 'yan'uwa da maƙwabta suka hallara a gidan Hajiya Amatu. Mutane sama da talatin suka hallara a tsakar gida. Maikano ya tsunbace mahaifiyarsa a goshi, ita kuma ta rungume shi tana kuka da farin ciki. Sannan ya tsunbace Samiha a kai, ya gode mata. Jimaminta bai ƙare ba, amma da ta ga mutanen da suka hallara, ta ce, "Yanzu na ji ƙarfi ya dawo mini." Daga ranar ta fara cin abinci da kyau, kuma ba ta ƙara rame ba. 

Tambayoyi:
Yaushe Hajiya Amatu ta zama bazawara?
Ta zama bazawara watanni shida da suka wuce, lokacin da mijinta ya rasu.
Me ya raunana Hajiya Amatu?
Jimami ne ya raunana ta, har ta rame.
Ina Samiha ta mayar da makwancin kakarta?
Ta mayar da makwancinta zuwa ɗakin da ke kusa da tsakar gida.
Me Samiha take yi kowane dare kafin barci?
Takan murza ƙafafun kakarta da mai.
Me ya sa ba a ji duriyar Maikano ba?
Wayarsa ta ɓace, kuma ya kwanta a asibiti saboda rashin lafiya.
Me Maikano ya yi da ya ga mahaifiyarsa?
Ya tsunbace ta a goshi.

lessons.title: Sayayyar kayan gida
lessons.summary: In Abuja, Safara'u has finished building her house and hires an adviser, Malam Ɗanhalima, for the furniture shopping; they both prefer Nigerian-made goods; he catches a trader trying to pass off mixed cloth as pure cotton and speaks harshly to him, keeps her from getting distracted by coloured lamps, and she buys all of a carpenter's chairs, which a trailer brings the next day.
lessons.text:
Safara'u ta gama gina gidanta a Abuja bayan shekaru biyar tana tara kuɗi. Amma ɗakunan babu komai a cikinsu. Ta san cewa sayayyar kayan gida tana da wahala, kuma ana iya kashe kuɗi da yawa a banza. Sai ta nemi mashawarci.

Mashawarcin da aka nuna mata shi ne Malam Ɗanhalima, wanda ya yi shekaru ashirin yana ba mutane shawara a kan adon gida. Ya zagaya gidan, sannan ya ce, "Kafin mu fara sayayya, ki faɗa mini abin da kike so."

Safara'u ta ce, "Ina son gida mai sauƙi, ba na son ado mai yawa. Kuma na gwammace in sayi kayan da aka yi a Najeriya fiye da kayan waje."

Malam Ɗanhalima ya ce, "Na ji daɗin haka. Ni ma na gwammace kayan gida."

Bayan kwana biyu suka tafi kasuwa tare. Shago na farko da suka shiga na labule ne. Mai shagon ya nuna musu wani farin labule ya ce, "Wannan auduga ce zalla, babu roba a ciki ko kaɗan. Daga ƙasar waje aka kawo shi." Safara'u ta kusa saya, amma Malam Ɗanhalima ya kama gefen labulen, ya murza shi tsakanin yatsunsa. Sannan ya ja zare ɗaya, ya kunna masa wuta. Zaren ya narke kamar roba, bai zama toka kamar auduga ba.

Sai mashawarcin ya yi wa mai shagon kakkausar magana: "Kana so ka ruɗa mu? Wannan ba auduga ba ce zalla. Roba ce aka haɗa da ɗan auduga, kuma ba daga ƙasar waje aka kawo ta ba." Mai shagon ya yi shiru, sannan ya ce ba shi ne ya ruɗa su ba, wanda yake kawo masa kaya ne ya ruɗa shi. Safara'u ta ce, "Da ba don kai ba, da an ruɗa ni." Ya ce, "Na yi masa kakkausar magana ne saboda irin wannan ƙarya tana cutar da mutane da yawa."

A shago na biyu, Safara'u ta shagala. Wani mai sayar da fitilu ya kunna fitilu masu launuka da yawa, ta tsaya tana kallo har ta manta da abin da suka zo saya. Malam Ɗanhalima ya ce, "Safara'u, kada ki shagala. Fitilun nan na ado ne kawai, ba su da amfani sosai. Mu je wajen kujeru."

A shago na uku suka sami wani kafinta wanda yake yin kujeru da tebura da itace. Kujerunsa masu kyau ne, masu ƙarfi. Safara'u ta ce, "Zan sayi kujerun nan kaf." Ta sayi kujerun kaf, guda goma sha biyu, tare da tebura biyu da gadaje uku. Mashawarcin ya yi dariya ya ce, "Kin kwashe kayan shagon kaf!"

Kayan ba za su shiga mota ba. Kafintan ya kira wani direban tirela. Washegari wata babbar tirela ta zo ta tsaya a ƙofar gidan Safara'u. Ma'aikata huɗu suka sauke kayan daga tirelar. Da tirelar ta tafi, Safara'u ta zauna a kan sabuwar kujera ta ce, "Wannan ita ce sayayya mafi kyau da na taɓa yi."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Safara'u ta nemi mashawarci?
Ta san sayayyar kayan gida tana da wahala, kuma ana iya kashe kuɗi a banza.
Waɗanne kaya Safara'u ta gwammace?
Ta gwammace kayan da aka yi a Najeriya.
Yaya mai shagon labule ya so ya ruɗa su?
Ya ce labulen auduga ce zalla, amma roba ce aka haɗa da ɗan auduga.
Me ya sa Safara'u ta shagala a shago na biyu?
Ta tsaya tana kallon fitilu masu launuka da yawa.
Wace irin magana mashawarcin ya yi wa mai shagon?
Ya yi masa kakkausar magana.

lessons.title: Lambun Malam Hamma
lessons.summary: In Gombe, the ward head urges residents to plant trees and announces a competition with three conditions, one against drying laundry on walls facing the street; the retired teacher Malam Hamma plants seedlings tied to sticks with gentle knots, counts the new buds, mixes cement for a small fountain, moves his wife Harira's washing line behind the house, and wins.
lessons.text:
A farkon damina, mai unguwa a wata unguwa a Gombe ya kira taro. Ya hori mazauna unguwar da su kula da tsabtar gidajensu, su kuma dasa itatuwa da furanni. Sannan ya sanar da wata gasa: a ƙarshen damina za a ba gidan da ya fi kyau a unguwar kyauta.

Kwamitin gasar ya gindaya sharuɗɗa uku. Na farko, kowane gida ya dasa itatuwa aƙalla biyar. Na biyu, kada a zubar da ruwan wanka a hanya. Na uku, kada a shanya kaya a kan katangar da take fuskantar titi. Sharuɗɗan da aka gindaya sun ba wasu mamaki, musamman na uku, saboda mata da yawa sukan shanya kaya a kan katanga.

Malam Hamma, wani malamin makaranta da ya yi ritaya, ya ji daɗin gasar. Ya ce wa matarsa Hajiya Harira, "Za mu yi zarra a wannan gasa. Babu gidan da zai fi namu kyau."

Washegari ya tafi wajen masu sayar da dashe a bakin kasuwa. Ya sayi dashen lemu, dashen mangwaro, dashen dabino da kuma dashen furanni. Ya haƙa ramuka a gaban gida, ya zuba taki, ya sa kowane dashe a ramin sa. Saboda iska, ya kafa ƙaramar sanda kusa da kowane dashe, ya ɗaure dashen a jikin sandar da igiya. Ya yi ƙulli a hankali, don kada ƙullin ya matse ɗan itacen. Hajiya Harira ta ce, "Ka koya mini wannan ƙulli." Ya nuna mata yadda ake yin ƙulli mai sauƙi wanda ba ya cutar da itace.

Bayan mako biyu, toho ya fara fitowa a jikin kowane dashe. Kowace safiya Malam Hamma yakan fita ya ƙirga sabon toho.

Sannan ya yanke shawarar gina ƙaramar maɓuɓɓuga a tsakiyar lambun. Ya sayi siminti da yashi. Ya kwaɓa siminti da yashi da ruwa a cikin wani babban kwano. Ya kwaɓa su har suka yi laushi, sannan ya gina wani ƙaramin kwano mai zagaye da bulo. Ya sa wani ƙaramin inji wanda yake tura ruwa sama. Da ya kunna injin, ruwa ya fara fitowa daga tsakiyar maɓuɓɓugar, yana faɗuwa da kyau. Yaran unguwa suka zo suna kallon maɓuɓɓugar.

Amma akwai matsala ɗaya: Hajiya Harira ta saba shanya kaya a kan katangar gaban gida. Malam Hamma ya tuna mata sharaɗin da kwamitin ya gindaya. Sai ya ɗaura igiya a bayan gida, inda ba a gani daga titi, ya ce, "Daga yau a nan za ki riƙa shanya kaya." Ta yi dariya ta ce, "Saboda gasa, na yarda."

A ƙarshen damina kwamitin ya zagaya gidaje. Da suka isa gidan Malam Hamma, sai suka ga dashe sun yi girma, toho ya zama ganye, maɓuɓɓuga tana fitar da ruwa, kuma babu kaya a kan katanga. Shugaban kwamitin ya ce, "Malam Hamma, ka yi zarra a wannan gasa." Mai unguwa ya ba shi kyautar kuɗi da takardar yabo.

Tambayoyi:
Me mai unguwa ya hori mazauna unguwar su yi?
Ya hori su da su kula da tsabtar gidajensu, su kuma dasa itatuwa da furanni.
Wane sharaɗi na uku kwamitin ya gindaya?
Ya gindaya cewa kada a shanya kaya a kan katangar da take fuskantar titi.
Me ya sa Malam Hamma ya yi ƙulli a hankali?
Don kada ƙullin ya matse ɗan itacen.
Me Malam Hamma ya kwaɓa?
Ya kwaɓa siminti da yashi da ruwa don ya gina maɓuɓɓuga.
Wa ya yi zarra a gasar?
Malam Hamma ne ya yi zarra a gasar.

lessons.title: Casun otal
lessons.summary: In Kaduna, sixteen-year-old Kabir lies that he is going to study and goes to a dance party at a hotel because his friends tempted him; gossip reaches his mother Hajiya Sakinatu, his father Malam Sadi wants to discipline him, the mother reminds him that the aim is to raise the boy well, Kabir calls his father a hypocrite, and over ice cream Kabir admits his foolishness.
lessons.text:
Kabir yana da shekara goma sha shida. Wata Juma'a da yamma ya ce wa mahaifiyarsa Hajiya Sakinatu zai je gidan abokinsa su yi karatu. Amma ba gidan abokinsa ya je ba. Ya je wani casu a wani otal a cikin garin Kaduna. Abokansa ne suka kwaɗaitar da shi. Sun ce masa, "Kowa zai zo casun nan. Za a yi kiɗa da rawa." Sun daɗe suna kwaɗaitar da shi, har ya yarda.

Washegari tsegumi ya fara yawo a unguwa. Wata mace a unguwar ta gaya wa Hajiya Sakinatu cewa ta ga ɗanta a ƙofar otal da dare. Wata kuma ta ƙara wa tsegumin gishiri, ta ce har da faɗa aka yi a casun. Hajiya Sakinatu ba ta son tsegumi, amma ta san dole ta tambayi ɗanta.

Ta kira shi a ɗakinta ta tambaye shi. Kabir ya yi shiru, sannan ya faɗi gaskiya. Ya ce ya je casu, kuma an yi faɗa a can har 'yan sanda suka zo.

Da mahaifinsa Malam Sadi ya ji labarin, ya fusata. Ya ce, "Dole in ladabtar da yaron nan. Zan karɓe wayarsa na wata ɗaya."

Hajiya Sakinatu ta ce, "Ka ladabtar da shi, amma kada ka manta abin da muke so. Muna so mu tarbiyyantar da shi, ba wai mu hukunta shi kawai ba. Idan ka ladabtar da yaro ba tare da ka yi masa bayani ba, zai koyi ɓoye abu ne kawai. Iyayenmu sun tarbiyyantar da mu da magana mai laushi da kuma hukunci."

Malam Sadi ya kira Kabir falo. Ya ce masa, "Casu ba wurin da ya dace da kai ba ne. Ka san haka." Sai Kabir ya ce, "Baba, kana cewa casu ba shi da kyau, amma kai kana kallon rawa a talabijin kowane dare. Wannan ba munafunci ba ne?"

Falo ya yi tsit. Malam Sadi ya yi shiru na ɗan lokaci, sannan ya ce, "Ka yi gaskiya a kan wannan. Daga yau ba zan sake kallon irin waɗannan shirye shirye ba. Amma kai ma, ka ce wa mahaifiyarka za ka je karatu, sai ka je casu. Faɗin abu ɗaya a gaban mutum, kana aikata wani a bayansa, shi ma munafunci ne."

Kabir ya ce, "Na yarda, Baba. Na yi saƙarci. Da 'yan sanda suka zo, na ga cewa saƙarci ne zuwa wurin."

Bayan kwana biyu, Hajiya Sakinatu ta ɗauki Kabir suka fita tare. Ta kai shi wani shago, ta saya musu askirim. Yayin da suke shan askirim, ta yi masa magana a hankali game da gaskiya da zaɓar abokan kirki. Kabir ya ce, "Mama, wannan askirim ya fi casun daɗi."

Malam Sadi ya karɓe wayar Kabir na mako biyu kawai, kuma ya ce Kabir zai riƙa taimaka masa a shago a ƙarshen mako. Kabir bai sake zuwa casu ba.

Tambayoyi:
Wa ya kwaɗaitar da Kabir ya je casu?
Abokansa ne suka kwaɗaitar da shi.
Ta yaya Hajiya Sakinatu ta ji labarin?
Ta ji ne daga tsegumin maƙwabta.
Me Hajiya Sakinatu ta ce game da ladabtar da Kabir?
Ta ce su ladabtar da shi, amma abin da suke so shi ne su tarbiyyantar da shi.
Me ya sa Kabir ya ce mahaifinsa yana munafunci?
Saboda mahaifinsa yana cewa casu ba shi da kyau, amma shi kansa yana kallon rawa a talabijin.
Me Kabir ya ce game da zuwansa casu?
Ya ce saƙarci ne ya yi.

lessons.title: Zauren Malam Sha'aibu
lessons.summary: In Sokoto, Malam Sha'aibu has taught fiqh in the entrance hall of his house for thirty years and writes his notes in Ajami; his grandson Ali is learning plurals in English, the grandfather explains congregational prayer, the two agree to teach each other English and Ajami, and Ali hears the class studying the chapter on apostasy.
lessons.text:
Malam Sha'aibu malamin fiƙihu ne a Sokoto. Shekaru talatin ke nan yana koyar da ɗalibai a zauren gidansa. Zauren babban ɗaki ne a ƙofar gida, mai tabarmi a ƙasa da tsofaffin littattafai a kan bango. Kowace rana bayan sallar La'asar ɗalibai kusan ashirin sukan zauna a kan tabarmi, Malam ya karanta musu littafin fiƙihu, ya kuma yi bayani.

Malam Sha'aibu ba ya rubutu da boko. Duk bayanansa yana rubuta su da ajami, wato Hausa da aka rubuta da haruffan Larabci. Yana da wani tsohon littafi wanda ya cika da rubutun ajami tun yana matashi.

Jikansa Ali yana zaune tare da shi. Ali ɗalibi ne a makarantar sakandare, kuma yana karatun Ingilishi. Wata rana Ali ya dawo daga makaranta da aikin gida na Ingilishi. Malaminsu ya ce kowa ya rubuta jimla goma a kan jam'i, wato yadda ake canza kalma daga ɗaya zuwa jam'i a Ingilishi. Ali ya zauna a ƙofar zaure yana rubutu.

Sa'ilin da ɗalibai suka tafi, Malam Sha'aibu ya zo ya zauna kusa da jikansa. Ya ce, "Me kake rubutawa?"

Ali ya ce, "Kaka, Ingilishi ne. Ana koya mana jam'i. A Ingilishi, idan kana so ka yi jam'i, sau da yawa sai ka ƙara harafi ɗaya kawai a ƙarshen kalmar."

Malam ya yi dariya ya ce, "Ai a fiƙihu ma akwai jam'i, amma ba na kalmomi ba. Sallar jam'i ita ce sallar da mutane suke yi tare a bayan liman. Ladan sallar jam'i ya fi na sallar mutum shi kaɗai."

Ali ya ce, "To, Kaka, ka koya mini ajami, ni kuma in koya maka Ingilishi." Malam Sha'aibu ya yarda. Daga ranar, kowane dare bayan sallar Isha, suna zama a zaure na awa ɗaya. Ali yana koya wa kakansa haruffan Ingilishi, Malam kuma yana koya wa Ali yadda ake rubuta Hausa da ajami.

Wata rana Ali ya ji ɗaliban kakansa suna nazarci wani babi a littafin fiƙihu, babin ridda. Sa'ilin da suka tashi, ya tambaya, "Kaka, mece ce ridda?"

Malam ya ce, "Ridda ita ce barin addinin Musulunci bayan mutum ya shiga. Malaman fiƙihu sun yi rubutu da yawa a kanta. A yau muna nazarci abin da malamai daban daban suka faɗa a kan ridda, domin ɗalibai su san cewa malamai ba su yarda a kan kowane abu ba."

Ali ya ce, "Kaka, kai ma ba ka san komai ba?"

Malam ya yi murmushi ya ce, "Babu wani mahaluƙi da ya san komai, ɗana. Ko malamin da ya fi kowa ilimi, mahaluƙi ne kamar kowa. Shi ya sa nake nazarci littattafan malamai da yawa, ba na malami ɗaya kaɗai ba."

A ƙarshen wata, Malam Sha'aibu ya rubuta sunansa da haruffan Ingilishi a takarda. Ali kuma ya rubuta sunan kakansa da ajami. Sa'ilin da Ali ya nuna wa malaminsu na Ingilishi takardar, malamin ya yi mamaki ya ce, "Ashe kana iya rubutun ajami?"

Tambayoyi:
A ina Malam Sha'aibu yake koyar da fiƙihu?
Yana koyar da fiƙihu a zauren gidansa.
Da me Malam Sha'aibu yake rubuta bayanansa?
Yana rubuta su da ajami, wato Hausa da aka rubuta da haruffan Larabci.
Wane aikin gida Ali ya dawo da shi?
Ya dawo da aikin gida na Ingilishi a kan jam'i.
Mene ne sallar jam'i?
Sallar jam'i ita ce sallar da mutane suke yi tare a bayan liman.
Me Malam ya ce game da mahaluƙi?
Ya ce babu wani mahaluƙi da ya san komai.

lessons.title: Wuta a gidan haya
lessons.summary: In a rented compound in Jos, the tenant Ɗandada sets fire to rubbish on a windy morning; the flames roar and the goods in his neighbour Malam Ɗanfulani's store are lost; the quarrel gets worse, a young man attacks Ɗandada, who hurts his skull, and the families clash; after a police inquiry the landlord Alhaji Tafida settles the matter.
lessons.text:
A wani gidan haya a Jos, iyalai huɗu suna zaune a ɗakunan da suke kewaye da tsakar gida guda. Mai gidan, Alhaji Tafida, yana zaune a wani gida daban, amma yakan zo kowane ƙarshen wata ya karɓi kuɗin haya. Ɗaya daga cikin dokokinsa shi ne kada wani ya cinna wa shara wuta a cikin gidan.

Wata ranar Lahadi da safe, Ɗandada, ɗaya daga cikin masu haya, ya tara shara a bayan gida, ya cinna mata wuta. Ya saba yin haka kowane mako duk da dokar mai gida. Amma a wannan rana iska tana kaɗawa da ƙarfi. Iska ta tura wutar zuwa ɗakin ajiyar maƙwabcinsa Malam Ɗanfulani, wanda aka yi rufinsa da kara. Wuta ta kama rufin, ta fara ruri. Ruri na wutar ya tayar da kowa a gidan.

Mutane suka fito da bokitai suna zuba ruwa. Wutar tana ruri, hayaƙi yana tashi sama. Bayan rabin awa aka kashe wutar, amma duk kayan da ke cikin ɗakin ajiyar sun salwanta: buhunan shinkafa uku, injin ɗinki, da tufafin yara. Malam Ɗanfulani ya ce kayansa da suka salwanta sun kai naira dubu ɗari biyu.

Sai rikici ya fara. Malam Ɗanfulani ya ce wa Ɗandada, "Kai ne ka cinna wuta, kai ne za ka biya." Ɗandada ya ce, "Iska ce ta kai wutar, ba ni ba." Maganar ta ta'azzara, muryoyinsu suka ɗaga. Ɗan Malam Ɗanfulani, wani matashi mai zafin rai, ya fito daga ɗaki ya farma Ɗandada, ya ture shi da ƙarfi. Ɗandada ya faɗi, kansa ya bugi bakin wani dutse. Sai ƙanne da 'yan'uwan Ɗandada suka fito, aka yi arangama tsakanin iyalan biyu a tsakar gida. Mata suna ihu, yara suna kuka. Abin ya ƙara ta'azzara har wani maƙwabci ya kira 'yan sanda.

'Yan sanda suka zo suka raba arangamar. Aka kai Ɗandada asibiti. Likita ya ɗauki hoton kwanyarsa, sai ya ce, "Kwanyarka ba ta karye ba, rauni ne kawai a fata." Aka ɗinke masa rauni, ya koma gida da yamma.

'Yan sanda suka fara bahasi. Sun tambayi kowane mutum a gidan abin da ya gani. Bayan kwana uku, bahasin ya nuna abubuwa biyu: na farko, Ɗandada ya karya dokar mai gida da ya cinna wa shara wuta a cikin gida; na biyu, ɗan Malam Ɗanfulani ne ya fara farma Ɗandada, ba Ɗandada ya fara ba.

Alhaji Tafida ya zo ya kira kowa a tsakar gida. Ya karanta abin da bahasin 'yan sanda ya nuna, sannan ya yanke hukunci. Ɗandada zai biya rabin kuɗin kayan da suka salwanta. Ɗan Malam Ɗanfulani zai nemi gafarar Ɗandada a gaban kowa. Daga yau kuma ba wanda zai cinna wa shara wuta a gidan: Alhaji Tafida zai sayi babban kwandon shara, kuma motar shara za ta riƙa zuwa kowane mako.

Matashin ya nemi gafara, Ɗandada ya karɓa. Suka gaisa, kuma arangamar ta ƙare a nan.

Tambayoyi:
Me Ɗandada ya yi da shara?
Ya tara shara a bayan gida ya cinna mata wuta.
Me ya faru da maganar ta ta'azzara?
Ɗan Malam Ɗanfulani ya farma Ɗandada, aka yi arangama tsakanin iyalan biyu.
Wa ya farma Ɗandada?
Ɗan Malam Ɗanfulani ne ya farma shi.
Me likita ya ce game da kwanyar Ɗandada?
Ya ce kwanyarsa ba ta karye ba, rauni ne kawai a fata.
Me bahasin 'yan sanda ya nuna?
Ya nuna cewa Ɗandada ya karya dokar mai gida, kuma ɗan Malam Ɗanfulani ne ya fara farma shi.

lessons.title: Albam ɗin kaka
lessons.summary: In Bauchi, Majida cleans her grandfather Malam Ɗanmaraya's room and finds an old photo album and a rolled poster; he tells her how he treated leprosy and ringworm in the villages, then worked at the airport radar, and how God provided for him; together they hang the poster and some photos in the sitting room of the house at the road junction.
lessons.text:
Majida tana taimaka wa kakanta Malam Ɗanmaraya ya gyara ɗakinsa a Bauchi. Gidan kakan yana mahaɗar hanyoyi biyu, a gefen babbar kasuwa. Tun da aka gina shi shekaru hamsin da suka wuce, mutane suke kiransa "gidan mahaɗa".

A cikin wata tsohuwar durowa, Majida ta sami wani babban albam mai murfin fata, da kuma wata takarda da aka naɗe. Ta kawo albam ɗin wajen kakanta ta ce, "Kaka, me ke cikin albam ɗin nan?"

Malam Ɗanmaraya ya buɗe albam ɗin a hankali. Hoto na farko na wani matashi ne sanye da farar riga, tsaye a gaban wani ƙaramin asibiti a ƙauye. Ya ce, "Ni ne wannan. A lokacin ina aikin lafiya a ƙauyuka. Aikina shi ne yaƙi da kuturta."

Majida ta ce, "Kuturta? Ashe akwai ta a ƙasarmu?"

"Ƙwarai kuwa," in ji shi. "A zamanin baya kuturta ta yi yawa a ƙauyuka. Mutane suna tsoron masu kuturta, har ana korar su daga gari. Mu kuma muna zuwa muna ba su magani, muna koya wa mutane cewa ana warkar da kuturta idan aka sha magani da wuri."

Ya juya shafi. A hoto na gaba yana tsaye da yara da yawa, kowannensu an aske masa kai. Ya ce, "Waɗannan yara suna da makero. Makero yana fitowa a kan yara a fata, musamman a kai. Muna shafa musu magani, muna kuma koya wa iyaye su riƙa wanke kan yara da sabulu."

Sai Majida ta buɗe takardar da aka naɗe. Wata tsohuwar fasta ce, mai hoton wata mace da ɗanta, da kuma rubutu mai girma: "Kuturta cuta ce, ba tsinuwa ba ce. Ana warkar da ita." Malam Ɗanmaraya ya ce, "Mu ne muka liƙa wannan fasta a kasuwanni da makarantu."

A ƙarshen albam ɗin akwai hotunan wani wuri daban: filin jirgin sama, da wata babbar na'ura mai juyawa a saman wani gini. Majida ta ce, "Wannan kuma fa?"

"Wannan radar ce," in ji kakan. "Bayan na bar aikin lafiya, na samu aiki a filin jirgin sama na Kano. Radar tana gano jiragen sama a sararin samaniya tun kafin su iso. Na yi shekaru goma sha biyar ina kula da radar."

Malam Ɗanmaraya ya rufe albam ɗin ya ce, "Allah ya azurta ni da aiki mai amfani, ya azurta ni da 'ya'ya da jikoki. Da kuɗin aikina ne na gina gidan nan na mahaɗa. Me kuma zan nema?"

Majida ta yi tunani, sannan ta ce, "Kaka, bari mu rataya fastar nan da wasu hotunan albam ɗin a falo. Kowane baƙo zai ga tarihinka." Kakan ya yarda. Ta sa hoton asibitin ƙauye, hoton yara masu makero da hoton radar a cikin gilashi, ta rataya su a bango tare da tsohuwar fasta. Tun daga ranar, duk wanda ya shigo falon gidan mahaɗa yakan tsaya yana kallon tarihin Malam Ɗanmaraya.

Tambayoyi:
A ina gidan Malam Ɗanmaraya yake?
Gidansa yana mahaɗar hanyoyi biyu a Bauchi.
Me Majida ta samu a cikin durowa?
Ta samu wani babban albam da wata tsohuwar fasta.
Wane aiki Malam Ɗanmaraya ya yi a ƙauyuka?
Ya yi aikin lafiya, yana yaƙi da kuturta da makero.
Da me Allah ya azurta Malam Ɗanmaraya?
Allah ya azurta shi da aiki mai amfani, da 'ya'ya da jikoki.
Me Majida ta yi da fasta da hotunan albam ɗin?
Ta rataya su a bango a falo.
